evidence.description: Resource bootstrap copies assets from 3:/ to 0:/ via FUN_0006ccf8; called after mount
Boot updater copies 3:/ZK-INKJET-NANO-BOOT.bin then 3:/ZK-INKJET-NANO-APP.bin via FUN_0006ccf8
File copy/IO routine used for firmware and resource transfers

next_steps: Analyze FUN_0005ebb8 for mount table and volume indexing
Search About-screen handler for 0.8/3.8GB usage calculation
Trace USB MSC setup to see which volume is exported (0:/ MINI) and if configurable
Review FUN_0006ccf8 call parameters for size checks or bounds
Search for hardcoded sector offsets or volume structures mapping 0:/ and 3:/
raw_note:
Findings so far:
- Strings: multiple 0:/ paths (fonts/resources) and 3:/ paths (firmware/UI). No 1:/ or 2:/ usage found.
- Resource bootstrap: FUN_0005cfb8 mounts volume using FUN_0005ebb8(&"0:/", "system"), then calls FUN_0006ccf8 to copy assets from 3:/obds/* into 0:/ (e.g., ZK-INKJET-RES-HW.zkml, fonts). Suggests 0:/ is working/internal mount point; 3:/ is source volume.
- Boot loader path: FUN_0006887c calls FUN_0006ccf8 to copy 3:/ZK-INKJET-NANO-BOOT.bin; on success falls through to copy 3:/ZK-INKJET-NANO-APP.bin (load addr params 0 / 0x3000000). File names hardcoded; no search across volumes observed.
- Copy/IO routine: FUN_0006ccf8 (~313 instr) handles file open/read/write with validation via FUN_0000e158 and buffer alloc 0x1000; used by both resource bootstrap and boot loader.
- FAT strings exist ("NO NAME FAT", "NO NAME FAT32", "FAT32") but mount logic not yet fully mapped; volume selection appears positional (0:/,3:/ only) rather than dynamic scan.
- Memory usage (About screen 0.8/3.8GB) and USB MSC volume mapping not yet located; further xrefs to USB/UI About handlers needed.

Gaps/TODO:
- Locate mount table/volume array (likely near FUN_0005ebb8) and understand why indices 0 and 3 are used.
- Find About-screen usage calculation and USB MSC volume selection logic.
- Determine if UDC exports 0:/ (MINI) only and whether 3:/ can be exposed.
- Check for size checks in FUN_0006ccf8 or callers when loading APP.bin/BOOT.bin.
- Map volume offsets/hardcoded sector addresses if present.
summary: Firmware uses dual-volume scheme: resource copier starts at FUN_0005cfb8, mounting "system" on 0:/ then copying assets from 3:/ to 0:/. Boot updater at FUN_0006887c loads 3:/ZK-INKJET-NANO-BOOT.bin then 3:/ZK-INKJET-NANO-APP.bin via file copy routine FUN_0006ccf8. Volume labels referenced are only 0:/ (fonts/resources) and 3:/ (firmware/UI). FAT strings present but no evidence of 1:/,2:/ usage. APP.bin has no trailing padding; free space not identified. USB MSC volume selection not yet resolved.
